preconditions.description: The number of problems is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
The required balance is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.length == n and all(1 <= a_i < a_j for i < j in output) and sum(a_i + a_j == a_k for i < j < k in output) == m)
postconditions.description: The output is either a list of n integers representing a valid score distribution or -1 if no such distribution exists. The list must satisfy the increasing order property and the balance requirement.
